method: Built-in image_gen tool, one photograph per call, generated sequentially
notes: Fictional unbranded cream ribbed crew socks; no user product photo was supplied.
Output 01 establishes the product. Remaining views are generated reference concepts.
Adult worn views are cropped below the knees, without footwear.
Public copies are Ecommerce template examples, not approved customer generations.

outputs.title: Pair Product Shot
outputs.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE standalone premium photorealistic ecommerce reference photograph, output 01 PAIR PRODUCT SHOT of a coherent ten-image Socks set. Establish a fictional unbranded pair of matching warm ivory/cream crew socks, adult size, fine cotton-rich knitted appearance, narrow regular vertical ribs from a clean double-layer ribbed cuff down the leg and across the instep, smoothly knitted reinforced heel and rounded toe in the SAME cream colour, neat subtle toe seam. No logos, stripes, patterns or colour blocking. The socks have ordinary crew length reaching the lower-to-mid calf, not ankle socks or knee highs. Product-only photograph: both socks are empty but naturally shaped with invisible internal support, standing upright on the foot sections. Place the matching pair slightly staggered, both pointing the same direction at a gentle three-quarter angle towards the camera, so the cuffs, ribbing, toe shapes and one heel profile can be read. The complete two socks, all cuffs, heels and toes, must fit in the image with breathing room. No visible mannequin or body parts. Seamless warm light-grey/off-white studio background, softly grounded contact shadow, soft directional studio lighting, realistic fine knit fibres and subtle natural fabric folds, accurate plausible sock anatomy and not rigid shoes. Neutral restrained product catalogue aesthetic, portrait 4:5 image, pair occupying approximately 78 percent of image height. No text, captions, numbers, graphic frames, collage, props, shoes, hanger or watermark. Generate just one finished photograph.
